The '''ATL (Air-to-Land) Interceptor''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] developed by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the predecessor of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Defender starfighter]].

==History==
The ATL Interceptors were used by the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] to defend [[Trigon One]]<ref name="EIT" /> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> in addition to use in short-range [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense.<ref name="TEGtW" />

The design of the ATL Interceptor was later used by the [[Republic Engineering Corporation]] to create the [[Defender starfighter]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as part of the [[Defender (ship-design program)|Defender]] program.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Defender starfighter entered service relatively quickly in the years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="TBoC">{{GalaxyCite|2|The Battle of Cadinth}}</ref><ref name="TEGtW" /> and was used for atmospheric and short-range space defense.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DROIDSATLinterceptor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ATL Interceptor from [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] toy line.]]
The ATL Interceptor from the animated television series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] was based on one of the last toys of the [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' toy line, the [http://www.toysrgus.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=39639 ATL Interceptor]. However, it had originally been designed as the [http://www.toysrgus.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=49115 Death Star Defender], which was intended for use in the [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|toy line]]. The same design was later used in [[West End Games]] RPG adventure ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' to create the Defender starfighter.<ref name="ObnF" />
